texts.Erp:Items:00001: An item with the same number already exists.
texts.Erp:Items:00003: You cannot delete an item that has ledger entries.
texts.Erp:Customers:00001: A customer with the same number already exists.
texts.Erp:Customers:00003: The customer's credit limit has been exceeded.
texts.Erp:Vendors:00001: A vendor with the same number already exists.
texts.Erp:GLAccounts:00001: A G/L account with the same number already exists.
texts.Erp:GLAccounts:00002: The G/L account was not found.
texts.Erp:GLAccounts:00003: Direct posting is not allowed on this G/L account.
texts.Erp:Documents:00002: The document has already been posted.
texts.Erp:Documents:00004: Document {documentNo} is not open. Reopen it before making changes.
texts.Erp:Documents:00005: Document {documentNo} has been posted and can no longer be changed.
texts.Erp:Companies:00002: Select a company first. This data belongs to a company and none is active.
texts.Erp:Companies:00003: The selected company does not exist or is not available to you.
texts.Erp:Dimensions:00001: A dimension with code {code} already exists.
texts.Erp:Dimensions:00002: Dimension {dimensionCode} already has a value with code {code}.
texts.Erp:Journals:00001: There is nothing to post in this journal batch.
texts.Erp:Journals:00002: Document {documentNo} is out of balance by {balance}. Each document must balance to zero before posting.
texts.Erp:Ledgers:00001: Posted ledger entries cannot be changed or deleted. Post a correcting entry instead.
texts.Erp:Items:00004: The code {code} is already in use.
texts.Erp:Documents:00006: A document with number {documentNo} already exists.
texts.ItemWillBeDeletedMessage: This record will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
texts.PostJournalConfirmation: All lines in this batch will be posted to the ledgers. Posted entries cannot be changed.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00001: The number series '{code}' does not exist.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00002: Number series '{code}' has no open line for {date}. Add a line with a starting date on or before that date.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00003: Number series '{code}' is used up: the ending number '{endingNo}' has been reached. Add a new line to the series.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00004: You cannot type a number here: number series '{code}' does not allow manual numbers. Leave the number blank to get the next one.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00005: Number series '{code}' must be used in date order. {date} is before the last date used, {lastDateUsed}.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00006: The number cannot be incremented because it contains no digits.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00007: A number series with code '{code}' already exists.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00008: Enter a number. No number series assigns one automatically here.
texts.Erp:NoSeries:00009: The number series line is not valid. {reason}
texts.Erp:Approvals:00001: User '{user}' is not in the Approval User Setup. Add them there first.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00002: No approver is defined for user '{user}' in the Approval User Setup.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00003: Nobody in the approval chain above '{user}' may approve an amount of {amount}. Raise an approval limit or mark the top approver as unlimited.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00004: An approval request for document '{documentNo}' is already pending.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00005: Document '{documentNo}' needs approval. Send an approval request; it is released when the approval is complete.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00006: This approval request is not open (status: {status}).
texts.Erp:Approvals:00007: Only the approver, '{approver}', or an approval administrator can act on this request.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00008: Document '{documentNo}' has no pending approval request to cancel.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00009: Only the sender or an approval administrator can cancel the approval request for '{documentNo}'.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00010: '{user}' has neither a substitute nor an approver to delegate to.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00011: Document '{documentNo}' is pending approval. Cancel the approval request first.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00012: The Approval User Setup contains a loop at user '{user}'.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00013: A workflow with code '{code}' already exists.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00014: User '{user}' already has an approval user setup.
texts.Erp:Approvals:00015: No enabled approval workflow applies to document '{documentNo}'. It can be released directly.
texts.Workflow:DisableBeforeEditing: Disable the workflow before changing or deleting it.
texts.DefaultNosHelp: Numbers are assigned automatically when the number is left blank.
texts.ManualNosHelp: People may type their own number instead of taking the next one.
texts.DateOrderHelp: Numbers must be assigned in date order. Required for posted invoices in some countries.
texts.NoSeriesLinesHelp: The line whose starting date is closest to the posting date is used, so a new line can start each year. Last no. used is kept by the system.
texts.SeriesWarning: The warning number has been reached. Extend the series.
texts.DocumentNumberingHelp: Which number series each kind of record draws from. Leave a field on "numbered by hand" to type numbers yourself.
texts.DocumentNoHelp: Leave blank to take the next number of the series.
texts.WorkflowsHelp: An enabled workflow makes documents of its kind need approval before they can be released or posted. Disable a workflow to change it.
texts.MinimumAmountHelp: Documents below this amount are released without approval. Zero means every document needs approval.
texts.DueDaysHelp: Days an approver has to respond. Zero means no due date.
texts.ApproverLimitTypeHelp: Approver chain: everyone up the chain until someone's limit covers the amount. Direct approver: only the sender's own approver. First qualified approver: only the first person whose limit covers it.
texts.EnableWorkflowConfirmation: Once enabled, documents of this kind will need approval before they can be released or posted. Continue?
texts.ApprovalUserSetupHelp: Who approves each person's requests, and up to what amount they may approve themselves. A request travels up this chain.
texts.SubstituteHelp: Who takes over when a request is delegated.
texts.ApprovalAdministratorHelp: May act on any approval request, whoever it is addressed to.
texts.RejectHelp: The document goes back to its sender, who can change it and ask again.
texts.DelegateHelp: Hand the request to this approver's substitute.
texts.DelegateConfirmation: The request will be handed to the approver's substitute. Continue?
texts.ApprovalAutoApproved: Within your own approval limit: the document was released.
texts.ApprovalRequestCanceled: The approval request was canceled and the document reopened.
texts.SelectADocument: Select a document to see its approval history and notes.
texts.PostDocumentConfirmation: Posting writes the ledger entries and cannot be undone. Continue?
